evidence_spans: We evaluate CAFE with a behavioral bit-sliced CIM simulator adapted from NeuroSim [9], extended to support signed Transformer bit-plane encodings and the conducting-cell-level FeFET error flow in Fig. 3, including bit-plane decomposition, on-current variation, bit-line accumulation, ADC quantization, and shift-and-add reconstruction.
CLM-MEM-0017.statement: The normalized hardware cost of uniform Diff-W/Diff-A encoding is 3.06.
